en: The postcard features an illustration bordered by a geometric black frame. The illustration depicts two men in stylized early 20th-century dress fighting, with one raising a fist and the other clutching his face. Their hats have fallen to the ground. In the background, a woman in patterned attire watches with a distressed or concerned posture. Below the scene, the German text 'GESPRÄCH ZWISCHEN RIVALEN' (Conversation Between Rivals) is displayed. The lower half of the postcard is blank, presumably for a message.
